description: Convert one instant into the local time of up to 12 IANA time zones at once, with the UTC offset in minutes for each, plus the Unix seconds and the canonical ISO-8601 UTC form. Daylight saving is handled by the runtime time-zone database, and an unknown zone is reported in gaps rather than skipped. Use it to schedule across regions, check business hours, or turn an ambiguous timestamp into an unambiguous one. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

at.description: ISO-8601 instant or Unix milliseconds (default: now)

zones.description: IANA time zone names, up to 12 (default UTC, Asia/Tokyo, America/New_York)

name: time-convert
